issues.on_page: 15 operating expense lines (Total column, and the same in the Without Donor Restrictions column) add to 312,072; printed Total Operating Expenses 312,145
issues.issue: Confirmed: the report itself doesn't add up. This is not a misread or a missed line. Every line was checked visually, and there are no other expense lines on p2. The printed total 312,145 is backed by the loss from operations (297,053 - 312,145 = -15,092), the net position roll-forward (1,853,323 - 9,452 = 1,843,871) and the p3 cash flow (goods and services payments 102,386 = 312,145 - employee costs 208,167 - depreciation 914 - AP increase 678). So one printed line item is probably 73 too low, but the page doesn't say which. As a result the business-type identity (beginning + receipts - disbursements = ending) will also be off by 73. Only a 'totals' entry was recorded; consider a matching 'business' entry.
The district's members are local governments, so these dues could be intergovernmental/state aid (county/other local governments). Judgment call.
